about_the_game:
Game Overview​

"Dark Eyes: The Narcotic Operation”, linked to the hit TV series "扫毒风暴", is an immersive narrative game. In 1988's Wanbei, thick with humid heat and latent danger, you embody Lin Qiangfeng, alias "A Gu", infiltrating drug lord——Boss Tiger to bring him to justice, Tiger may seem like the one in charge here, but in reality, there are other forces watching covetously, waiting for an opportunity to take his place, which making your mission far more perilous. This game is not just a story; it's a tribute to the countless anti-narcotics police officers who stand as walls with their bodies, guarding the peace of the country and its people.​

Plot Experience​

Undercover life is a knife-edge dance. In a floral shirt, Hanging around the seedy, mixed-up streets, every breath is cautious. You'll meet a tough ally who might betray you, or a stranger whose glance saves you. Starting as a lowly gofer—serving tea, watching streets—you learn to read faces, navigate tangled interests. Climbing to the gang's top, entering Boss Tiger’s gloomy, antique-filled office, you face his scrutiny and the watchful eyes of his shadowy backers. Success nears, but its cost could be staggering, just as the real anti-narcotics heroes risk everything to uphold justice.​

Rich Choices & Plots​

Over 100 choices lead to 400+ distinct scenarios. Obey Boss Tiger to eliminate a "traitor" (a police informant) for trust, or sneakily protect them? Report partial evidence, or risk deeper infiltration to expose his hidden backers? A careless word gains allies; a hesitant look sparks suspicion—even from the shadow force—spelling doom. Your choices between conscience and duty write your legend, mirroring the tough decisions real anti-narcotics police make daily.​

Key Characters & Endings​

You'll encounter 10+ characters shaping the outcome. They’re Boss Tiger loyalists, gray-area businessmen, or fellow undercover agents. Your choices make them allies or enemies, triggering chain reactions that alter the ending: take down Boss Tiger and his backers, perish in the storm, or carve an unexpected path—all hinge on your interactions. Each ending is a reminder of the sacrifices made by those who stand as walls against the criminals.​

Game Features​

  • Deep Immersion: Tied to the TV series, 1988 Wanbei—neon streets, mahjong alleys, drug dens—puts you in the tense undercover world, especially when tangling with the shadow force, letting you glimpse the harsh reality anti-narcotics police face.​

  • Branching Plots: Every decision ripples outward, unlocking relationships, secrets, and endings. Capture Brother Hu and his backers, die, or fall to temptation—you control it all, experiencing the weight of responsibility borne by real heroes.​

  • Authentic Settings: Nostalgic video halls, busy markets, guarded labs, opulent clubs recreate 1988 Wanbei, with dangers and opportunities in every corner, reflecting the environments where anti-narcotics police carry out their missions.​

  • Character Growth: From flustered novice to calm negotiator, A Gu’s growth—vital when facing the shadow force—depends on your choices, paralleling the development of real anti-narcotics officers as they hone their skills in the line of duty.​

As Wanbei’s night falls, what secrets lurk? What hides behind Boss Tiger’s smile and his backers’ masks? Don the "A Gu" disguise, step into "Dark Eyes", and write your justice story. Through this journey, may we always remember: there are those who take on the darkness so that we may live in light—they are the walls that guard our nation's peace. Coming soon to Steam.

content_descriptors.notes:
This is an interactive film game where players take on the role of an undercover police officer tasked with completing Anti-drug missions in a fictional city. 
This game contains depictions of crime, violence, gore, nudity or sexual content, as well as sensitive themes such as drug trafficking, drug use, excessive drinking, suicide or self-harm. It may not be suitable for all ages. We strongly advise that only players aged 16 and above purchase this title.

short_description: Step into the role of a shadowed undercover police officer in Dark Eyes, brave an area dominated by vice and crime, where allies and enemies blur. Every smirk, tear, and lie tightens the web of deceit—will you destroy the empire or lose yourself in its shadows?

English, Simplified Chinese*
